system.description:
Trained by no single circle — an itinerant tradition passed between solitary druids, hermits, and wandering teachers. Unaffiliated, beholden to no Hierophant.

  • Wild Instinct: Once per encounter, shift as part of your movement — the wanderer's instincts are honed for surprise transitions.
  • Horizon Reader: Advantage on Nature Lore checks in any region after spending at least one full day in it, without needing to formally designate it as a trained region.
